title: The Truman Show — Everyone Knows Truman Is Being Watched. So Why Doesn't Anyone Tell Him?
framing: 70% Active Cinematic Framing (1080x1344) with Ambient Blur Backdrop

beats.narration_text: Millions of people know Truman is being watched. But almost nobody tries to stop it.
beats.visual_description: Truman steps outside his pristine suburban Seahaven home, greeting neighbors with his cheerful catchphrase.

beats.narration_text: Every neighbour, conversation, and coincidence in Seahaven is staged by a billion-dollar television broadcast. Yet Truman genuinely believes his life is ordinary.
beats.visual_description: Sirius 9 studio spotlight crashes from the cloudless artificial sky onto the pavement as hidden surveillance monitors Truman.

beats.narration_text: Outside the dome, millions of viewers watch his deepest heartbreaks, private anxieties, and daily routines. They feel real affection for him—and they never turn the television off.
beats.visual_description: Everyday viewers glued to television screens: two elderly women with Truman pillows, man soaking in bathtub, bar patrons.

beats.narration_text: That is the film's chilling contradiction: their entertainment requires his imprisonment. They can weep for his pain while silently demanding that the cameras keep rolling.
beats.visual_description: Christof in the lunar control room overlooking the giant curved projection screen, directing Truman's life like a deity.

beats.narration_text: Truman thinks the entire world is watching him. But he doesn't realize that the people watching have become part of the reason he cannot escape.
beats.visual_description: Truman in his car intercepts the production radio frequency reciting his exact movements, realizing his existence is tracked.

beats.narration_text: And that's what makes the film so uncomfortable. Sometimes, caring about someone's story isn't the same as caring about their freedom.
beats.visual_description: Truman reaches the painted sky wall staircase, bows to Christof and the global audience, and steps through the dark exit.
